claim_boundary.reason: The 2011-2017 interval overlaps earlier IRIS-SEP development planning/inspection and the selected sources include retrospective/derived archive products. Results may support mechanism discovery and locked-method development, but not an untouched final-skill claim.

research_question: When does a fresh reduced-input SEP forecast outperform a stale joint-input forecast, and can a small rule using only issue-time information predict that crossover?

proton.semantics: Five-minute integral proton flux above 10 MeV; Av is NASA OMNIWeb's documented average of NOAA GOES-13 eastward- and westward-looking sensors.

xrs.timestamp_semantics: Averaged operational timestamps are approximately 1-3 seconds after the start of the averaging interval; feature construction remains past-only at issue time.
xrs.quality_rule: Reject nonfinite/fill-valued samples and samples carrying a nonzero operational quality flag when that flag is present. A zero flag is not interpreted as proof of perfect data quality.

delay_experiment.primary_manipulation: Delay one modality at a time before feature aggregation while preserving the identical forecast-opportunity cohort.

switching_policies.simple_fixed_expiry: Select a single modality-specific time-to-live cutoff on threshold_and_rule_selection only.
switching_policies.simple_confidence_rule: Select one fixed confidence/reliability rejection rule on threshold_and_rule_selection only.
switching_policies.adaptive_rule: Fit one small interpretable state-dependent rule on development roles only; no score-role feature or threshold selection.

primary_evaluation.mechanism_result: Paired performance-versus-input-age curves and whether joint-versus-reduced model ordering reverses.
primary_evaluation.policy_comparison: Locked adaptive rule versus best prespecified simple rule selected without retrospective_score outcomes.
primary_evaluation.coverage_accounting: Event-positive abstentions count as unwarned events in end-to-end detection accounting and are also reported separately.
primary_evaluation.paired_uncertainty: Event/quiet-block paired bootstrap; repeated timestamps and repeated masks do not count as independent events.

stop_rules: If source metadata/readiness fails, do not inspect labels or train.
If clean-input joint and simple models do not show useful signal over climatology, stop policy embellishment.
If no crossover exists on the frozen delay grid, report the negative result and do not search post-hoc strata.
If a fixed expiry rule performs as well as the adaptive rule within uncertainty, prefer the fixed rule.
Do not relabel the retrospective_score role as independent final evidence.
